knowledge.name: Frozen synthetic inventory network
knowledge.detail: Bundled stores, warehouses, SKUs, on-hand balances, safety stock, lead times, demand weights, and sell-through ground every view.

knowledge.name: Inventory rules and locked case contract
knowledge.detail: Packaged rules define approved personas, exact routes, evidence anchors, identifier handling, verification, and the no-side-effect boundary.

intelligence_processing.name: Location and SKU visibility
intelligence_processing.detail: Shows synthetic on-hand, safety stock, status, and days of supply by store or network, with system-of-record verification required.

intelligence_processing.name: Stock exception review
intelligence_processing.detail: Identifies critical, out-of-stock, and low-stock review candidates without issuing a transfer or replenishment command.

intelligence_processing.name: Replenishment scenario modeling
intelligence_processing.detail: Calculates a draft 14-day scenario with quantities, source warehouse, lead time, and estimated cost without creating an order.

intelligence_processing.name: Channel allocation scenario
intelligence_processing.detail: Compares demand weights, planning units, and coverage across store, online, BOPIS, and marketplace channels without reserving stock.

clients_user_interface.name: Copilot Studio Draft experience
clients_user_interface.detail: Provides role-specific review for Inventory Planners, Store Managers, and Category Managers while the pilot remains an unpublished Draft.

clients_user_interface.name: Portable Brainstem chat experience
clients_user_interface.detail: Runs the single-file InventoryVisibilityAgent through local Brainstem chat and UI endpoints with synthetic data and no credentials.

clients_user_interface.name: Operator evidence review
clients_user_interface.detail: Presents quantities, assumptions, exceptions, verification needs, and approval gates for an authorized operator to assess before action.

management_reporting.name: Inventory visibility snapshot
management_reporting.detail: Reports store and SKU identity, on-hand quantity, safety stock, status, days of supply, and the synthetic network total.

management_reporting.name: Stock candidate and warning brief
management_reporting.detail: Separates critical and out-of-stock candidates from low-stock warnings and labels suggested responses as review guidance only.

management_reporting.name: Planning scenario reports
management_reporting.detail: Summarizes draft replenishment cost and channel coverage tradeoffs without recording an allocation, promise, transfer, or purchase.

tools.name: Portable RAPP Inventory Visibility Agent
tools.detail: Single-file InventoryVisibilityAgent implements four deterministic read-only operations over bundled synthetic inventory records.

tools.name: Microsoft Copilot Studio
tools.detail: Hosts two knowledge files and four skills; manual and CLI-authored agents passed all four preview cases and remain unpublished Drafts.

tools.name: Power Platform CLI
tools.detail: Initializes, pulls, validates, pushes, and exports the CLI-authored package while publication remains a separate authorized step.

tools.name: Dynamics 365 Commerce or ERP
tools.detail: Approved production seam for read-only inventory data; the packaged pilot contains synthetic evidence and no live write integration.

tools.name: Microsoft Teams
tools.detail: Approved planning-review seam for operators; the current package sends no message and executes no inventory decision or workflow.

tools.name: Foundation model selected by environment
tools.detail: The deployment environment supplies conversational routing and generation; preview evidence records Claude Sonnet 4.6.

supporting_features.name: Four deterministic inventory operations
supporting_features.detail: Routes visibility, stock-alert, replenishment, and channel-planning intents to operation-specific synthetic evidence.

supporting_features.name: Synthetic-only grounding
supporting_features.detail: Uses the bundled complete record set and rules; every quantity is fictional and requires authorized system-of-record verification.

supporting_features.name: Evidence-first response contract
supporting_features.detail: Preserves persona headings, scenario headings, exact identifiers, planning assumptions, caveats, and locked acceptance anchors.

supporting_features.name: Identifier and source validation
supporting_features.detail: Rejects unknown SKU or location identifiers and non-synthetic data-source requests instead of approximating or inventing evidence.

supporting_features.name: Authorized operator review gates
supporting_features.detail: Keeps every output a draft, scenario, summary, or recommendation until an authorized operator verifies evidence and approves action.

supporting_features.name: No stock or promise mutation
supporting_features.detail: Never reserves, transfers, replenishes, allocates, promises, sells, or purchases stock and never claims those actions occurred.

supporting_features.name: Draft, validation, and export controls
supporting_features.detail: Records four passing locked cases, an unpublished Dataverse Draft, and an unmanaged export requiring administrator review before publish.
